title: पीछे मत देखना
logline: A frightened man asks her not to look behind her. You expect a ghost. It is a birthday tiffin for a daughter who is not alive.
end_card: कल — टिफ़िन के अंदर क्या था।
end_card_roman: Kal — tiffin ke andar kya tha.

shots.vo: रात के दो बजे एक सवारी ने मुझसे कहा — दीदी, पीछे मत देखना।
shots.vo_roman: Raat ke do baje ek sawaari ne mujhse kaha — didi, peeche mat dekhna.
shots.prompt: CHARACTER close up, her face lit only by the warm dashboard glow from below, eyes to camera, seated at the handlebars of the auto-rickshaw at night, rain on the windscreen behind her, everything else in darkness

shots.vo: लखनऊ की सड़कें दो बजे खाली हो जाती हैं। मैं खाली ही चलती हूँ।
shots.vo_roman: Lucknow ki sadkein do baje khaali ho jaati hain. Main khaali hi chalti hoon.
shots.prompt: wide shot of an empty wet Lucknow street at 2am, a single black-and-yellow auto-rickshaw approaching, its headlight the only strong light, sodium streetlights, closed shutters, standing water reflecting orange

shots.vo: वो हाथ में एक टिफ़िन लिए बैठा। दोनों हाथों से पकड़े हुए, जैसे कोई गिर न जाए।
shots.vo_roman: Woh haath mein ek tiffin liye baitha. Dono haathon se pakde hue, jaise koi gir na jaaye.
shots.prompt: a thin Indian man about fifty years old sitting in the back of the auto-rickshaw at night, holding a steel tiffin carrier with both hands against his chest, his face half in shadow, streetlights passing outside

shots.vo: बोला — चलिए दीदी। और पीछे मत देखना।
shots.vo_roman: Bola — chaliye didi. Aur peeche mat dekhna.
shots.prompt: over-the-shoulder shot from the front seat of the auto-rickshaw looking back at the passenger, his face half lit by a passing streetlight, his mouth mid-sentence, the steel tiffin in his lap

shots.vo: मैंने देख लिया। पीछे कोई नहीं था। सिर्फ़ वो, और वो टिफ़िन।
shots.vo_roman: Maine dekh liya. Peeche koi nahi tha. Sirf woh, aur woh tiffin.
shots.prompt: CHARACTER seated at the handlebars of the auto-rickshaw at night, seen reflected in a cracked rear-view mirror, her eyes raised to the mirror, dashboard light warm on her face from below, the Hanuman idol and dried marigold garland out of focus in the foreground
shots.motion: her eyes rise to the mirror and hold

shots.vo: आज मेरी बेटी का जन्मदिन है, उसने कहा। उसे खीर बहुत पसंद है।
shots.vo_roman: Aaj meri beti ka janamdin hai, usne kaha. Use kheer bahut pasand hai.
shots.prompt: close up of the man's weathered hands gripping the steel tiffin in his lap, heavy rain running down the auto-rickshaw windscreen behind, wiper blade blurred mid-sweep, warm and cold light mixing
shots.motion: static with rain and wiper layers

shots.vo: मैंने पता पूछा नहीं था। उसने बताया भी नहीं था।
shots.vo_roman: Maine pata poocha nahi tha. Usne bataya bhi nahi tha.
shots.prompt: the auto-rickshaw stopped at night in front of a tall rusted iron cemetery gate, wet road, one sodium lamp above the gate, gravestones faintly visible beyond the bars, rain falling through the light
shots.motion: slow reveal as the gate comes into frame

shots.vo: वो उतर गया। टिफ़िन वहीं रह गया।
shots.vo_roman: Woh utar gaya. Tiffin wahin reh gaya.
shots.prompt: the empty back seat of the auto-rickshaw at night, a steel tiffin carrier left alone on the seat, the open side of the auto showing the cemetery gate out of focus behind, rain
